meta.title: US subscribers at the end of September 2026
meta.question: How many US users had an active subscription at the end of September?
meta.author: Codex

items: Check numbers refer to the individual JSONL evidence files in the accompanying folder.
Silver is curated detail; Gold is a prebuilt summary; source history provides an independent recount.
Subscriber
A distinct user with an access-granting subscription period at the specified instant.
US user
A user whose recorded current country at the user snapshot is US.

blocks.text: 349 US users had subscriber access at the end of September 2026 (check 5).

items: The approved month-end instant is 2026-10-01 00:00:00 UTC. Access includes active and cancel-at-period-end statuses (supporting metrics v1.1; lifecycle v1.0).
The 349 include 37 users with cancel-at-period-end access. No qualifying US user had a flagged subscription period or overlapping qualifying periods (check 7).
Source history independently gives 349 US users and 1,011 subscribers overall; the overall total matches Gold (check 6).
Country is the recorded user country at the 2026-09-30 23:59:59 UTC snapshot, as confirmed by the requester. It is not a historical location measure.
Access starts at or before the instant and ends after it or has no end; distinct users are counted once.
Gold has no matching country dimension for this subscriber measure, so the answer uses Silver subscription access joined to Silver user profiles.
Inventory and metadata (checks 1-4); Silver count (check 5); source and Gold reconciliation (check 6); quality and boundary checks (checks 7-8).
A point-in-time count was requested, so no causal hypotheses or movement decomposition were necessary.
No subscribers had missing profile or country in the source recount; zero qualifying US users had flagged or overlapping periods (checks 6-7).
No US access periods start or end exactly at the boundary (check 8).

The single recorded build succeeded and its reconciliation checks passed (check 3). The builder hash matches the local builder. The build registry hash differs from the current registry file; their equivalence is not established.

The source recount agrees with the Silver result under the current documented rule. The snapshot identifier is metadata, not a verified content hash; post-build source freshness was not independently fingerprinted.
The database is a synthetic fixture, not a production customer population. Snapshot country is not proof of location at the historical instant.

The repository directory has no Git metadata; neither commit nor download date could be verified. Files were inspected on 2026-11-09; AGENTS.md has a 2026-11-09 20:12:48 IST modification time, which is not evidence of download time.
q01: layer inventory; q02: snapshot metadata; q03: build status and reconciliation; q04: schemas.
q05: country counts; q06: source and Gold reconciliation; q07: exceptions, overlaps and cancellation; q08: boundary records.
Full SQL, results, timings and row-limit status are in the corresponding JSONL evidence files. No query was truncated.
